description: This Dart file defines a Flutter ChangeNotifier class `MenuProvider` that manages menu data, including categories and items, with offline caching, demo seed data, analytics logging, and data retrieval methods.

classes.name: MenuProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that provides menu categories and items with offline caching and analytics integration.

methods.name: MenuProvider
methods.description: Constructor initializing the provider with cache and analytics services.

methods.name: loadMenu
methods.description: Loads menu data from cache or seeds demo data if cache is empty; optionally logs event if initial load.

methods.name: itemsByCategory
methods.description: Returns a list of menu items filtered by the specified category ID.

methods.name: itemById
methods.description: Retrieves a menu item by its ID, or null if not found.

methods.name: _seedDemoMenu
methods.description: Populates the provider with demo menu categories and items, primarily for offline support and testing.
